strategy.thesis: Blackbird is a generalist, sector-agnostic Australian/NZ VC that has increasingly backed healthtech as AI applications matured, with a portfolio including AI diagnostics imaging companies (Harrison.ai, See-Mode) and consumer digital-health platform Eucalyptus, one of its largest exits.

summary.en: Sydney-based generalist early-to-growth stage VC and one of the most active investors in the Australian tech ecosystem; has built a substantial healthtech track record via AI-diagnostics and digital-health bets including Harrison.ai and Eucalyptus.

strategy.thesis: AirTree is a generalist ANZ technology VC investing from seed to growth; its health nexus runs through consumer telehealth (Eucalyptus, Chemist2U), ambient-AI for healthcare providers (Ambience Healthcare), and longevity/preventive health (Everlab).

summary.en: One of Australia's largest early-stage tech VCs (~AU$2B AUM across five funds); backs a cluster of health portfolio companies spanning digital pharmacy, ambient clinical AI, telehealth and longevity medicine.
